biggest_catch: Earnings are entirely variable - you earn only when your content sells; commissions are rank-based and paid in credits.
catches: Current official guide: single-purchase commissions by rank - general 22-42%, exclusive creators 30-53%, person-exclusive 42-58%; video 40% (50% for exclusive-sale setting)
Earnings paid in credits; cash-out at 10+ credits (50+ for overseas creators), ¥220 fee per exchange, paid on the 10th of the second following month; withholding tax applies
Exclusive-sale program increases royalty but requires not selling on other stock sites (90-day termination notice)
Terms are primarily in Japanese; English-language support exists via pixtastock.com
You retain copyright; Pixta group may use content for its own promotion without additional payment per terms

c1.evidence: PIXTA (pixta.jp) - Japanese digital stock marketplace (photos, illustrations, video, music) operating since 2006. Current official creator guide '獲得クレジットとお支払いについて' (pixta.jp/guide/?p=3336, updated 2025-02-21) loaded 2026-09-23 with the full current commission table.

c2.evidence: Official Pixta terms: creators are paid sales rewards in credits per Pixta's conversion rate; cash-out at 10 credits (¥1,000 worth). Official announcement: Market Freeze option pays commission by creator rank up to 58% (e.g. rank 6 = 58%, ¥5,000 sale → 29 credits).

c3.evidence: Concretely conditional: register as creator, upload, sell, accrue credits, cash out.

c4.evidence: No entry fee to become a creator. Not pay-to-play.
